result.ca_name_from_pdf: China Financial Certification Authority Co., Ltd.
result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities - SSL Baseline - v2.8

disclosed_matters.summary: CFCA failed to respond timely to Google Root Program email regarding certificate issuance error, resulting in incident reporting Bug 1888881 filed on 4 March 2024 and closed 2 April 2025.

CFCA failed to receive two CPRs within the time requirement of Section 4.9.5 of the TLS BRs, resulting in Bug 1959733 filed 10 April 2025 and closed 16 July 2025, with CCADB contact email subsequently updated.

CFCA failed to respond within 7 days as required by Incident Reporting Guidelines during handling of Bugs 1888881, 1888882, 1949131, and 1886135, leading to implementation of automation workflow solution.

Three SSL certificates issued by CFCA contained basicConstraints extension errors identified by Google Root Program; additional mis-issued certificates found during internal investigation and remediated by 26 September 2024 (Bug 1886135).
CFCA implemented automation workflow solution on 3 April 2025 to minimize delayed responses in incident reporting (Bug 1955799), which was closed 11 April 2025.
